steps: Entered seed QU-CHN-LEO01 under Play a seed
Month 1: chose Inspect every energy cargo (the loud option)
Month 2: Full desk, All orders, Declare war on Japan, confirmed the No undo warning
Chain reaction: US declared war on China, mission failed at month 2, F grade, Warmonger title
scenarios.notes: Wild move worked and the refusal-style warning named the mission it would break. Great for stream.

steps: Played months 1-12 mostly on cabinet picks, Map mode months 2-3
Reached the reveal at month 12, went through all 8 stages
Pressed New game from the ranking stage, back at the title, started another game
scenarios.notes: Missed the goal by 3 points (117 of 120) and got a D with 562/1000.

friction.expected: Pressing the button label opens the seed box
friction.happened: Clicking by label failed twice; only a text tap worked. The code box has no visible focus cue and I had to tap into the field before typing.
Tapping the title text did nothing, tapping the card image worked. Unsure if the card or the small Accept cabinet pick link was the control.
The Some help example is about Donetsk and Kramatorsk, nothing to do with China. I picked Guide me because I do not know regional names.
Busan trade truce, Zhang Youxia, Central Military Commission: names I do not know, no tap-to-explain there.
Says Australia ran 2 covert operations against me, nonsense in a China game I played for 2 months.

friction.expected: See the crisis I am deciding
friction.happened: In Map mode the crisis answer went through on the cabinet pick without me ever reading the crisis; the paper then showed a 'Summit' handshake picture for a spy order. Felt blind.
'Remember Germany's offer? United States asks for a naval base in China' read as nonsense.

friction.expected: Score number counts up on its own
friction.happened: Presidency Score sits at 0 for a couple of seconds then jumps; on a quick screenshot it looks broken.
Verdict says missed 120 by 3 (117) yet finish says par 115; ranking says better than 0% of simulated leaders at 562 while random staff scores 523.

friction.expected: Declare war on Japan is a bad moment
friction.happened: It is listed under 'What went well' (approval rose) while the inspect order is under 'went badly'.

friction.expected: Fills the screen like a stinger
friction.happened: Content sits in the left two thirds, right third and lower half empty; static cards, looks like a dashboard on camera.
Buttons sit under the footer bar and need a scroll; the footer has its own Share card button.

bugs.title: Verdict and ranking numbers contradict each other
steps: Finish the seed game with score 117
bugs.actual: Missed 120 by 3 but par shown 115; 562 shown as better than 0% while above the random-staff marker 523

bugs.title: Australia covert operations against a China player
bugs.expected: Covert ops that make sense or none
bugs.actual: Australia ran 2 operations against you, shown in the declassified card

bugs.title: Presidency score shows 0 before counting up
bugs.actual: Stays 0 for about 2 seconds with filled component bars below

suggestions.what: Make the end stages fill a 1920 wide stream layout and animate (big grade slam, seal drop-in) instead of static cards
After a war on a rival, show a short full-screen war stinger before the result card (the war map art exists)
In Map mode, show the crisis as a banner with the three answers instead of auto-taking the cabinet pick
Put a Post to chat button first on the ranking stage and keep Save card / Copy text next to it, above the fold
Tap-to-explain on names inside The truth table

delight: Declare war on Japan: the No undo confirm named the exact goal it would break, then the US joining the war and the MISSION FAILED stamp. Exactly the clip (screenshots 016, 018, 021)
Share card quotes my own best moment, 'Declare war on Japan, month 2' (029)
Blocked orders say why in one line (Japan will not sign a pact across the bloc line) (015)
Result card with big +8 World tension number and the newspaper (009, 010)
Map mode: tapping Taiwan opens orders on the spot (033)

fun.reason: The war chain reaction was great; the 12 month run on cabinet picks was a lot of Next month presses.

clarity.reason: Goal line, mission and warnings were clear; a few reveal numbers contradict.

visual.reason: Illustrated scenes and newspaper look good; reveal stages are static and empty on desktop.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Mission failed stamp, grades, seals feel like a game.

agency.reason: Wild move allowed with a clear warning; blocked orders explained themselves.

realism.reason: Japan war pulling in the US was believable; Australia spying and Germany offer lines were not.

replay.reason: Replay same opening and seed beat target pulled me back; compare runs line is nice.

recommend.reason: I would show chat the war run; the end of a peaceful run is a D and not worth posting.

verbatim: I declared war on Japan and the whole screen told me I'd wrecked my own mission. That's the clip. The calm 12 months after it was a lot of Next month.
